newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes raided suspected guerrilla targets in the highlands of south Lebanon on Saturday, Lebanese security sources said.

They said two planes fired a total of six rockets into the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties.
Hizbollah is fighting a guerrilla war to oust Israeli troops and their local militia allies from a border zone they occupy in south Lebanon.
